questions.question: Against which nation is the long oracle of Jeremiah 48?
What does Jeremiah 48 say Moab had been at ease in?
options: Its strong walls that no army on earth could ever once breach
The favor of the many gods that it had so long served
Complacency, like wine settled on its dregs, never poured out
Its great wealth that it had gathered in from many nations
questions.answer: Complacency, like wine settled on its dregs, never poured out

questions.question: Despite judgment, God promises to restore the fortunes of Moab in the latter days.
The oracle concerning _____. Woe to Nebo, for it is laid waste!
Moab has been at _____ from his youth and has settled on his dregs.
